items.titleZh: 法拉利将在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季最大升级
items.summaryZh: 法拉利计划在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季第四套、也是规模最大的空气动力学升级包，涉及底板、侧箱和上部车身。

media.altZh: 法拉利将在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季最大升级 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: What Ferrari's changing with its biggest F1 upgrade of 2026
items.summaryEn: Ferrari is set to introduce its fourth and largest aerodynamic upgrade package of the 2026 season at the United States Grand Prix, covering the floor, sidepods and upper bodywork.
detailZh: 法拉利正准备在美国大奖赛推出其2026年F1赛季的第四套、也是最重要的一套空气动力学升级包。
奥斯汀的这套升级是SF-26计划中最后一次如此规模的开发包，而马拉内罗的注意力如今已基本转向明年赛车的开发——由于规则限制和根本性的空气动力学选择，那辆车将完全不同。
美洲赛道的更新将涉及赛车多个区域，包括对底板、侧箱和上部车身的修改。
据我们的信息，与一些主要竞争对手不同，法拉利决定不彻底改变其侧箱的空气动力学概念。
迈凯伦和梅赛德斯，尤其是后者，最近通过最新升级对其概念进行了重大改变，大幅修改了侧箱的形状以及气流沿侧箱流动的方式。两支车队似乎都没有立即在赛道上实现其在风洞和CFD模拟中看到的效果。
另一方面，法拉利更倾向于与SF-26当前架构保持更大的连续性。
据了解，法拉利主要致力于优化其现有解决方案，而没有对车身进行根本性改变。据信主要目标是降低阻力，因为SF-26在这方面仍有些吃力。（法拉利动力较弱的引擎对此也没有帮助。）
因此，车队更倾向于采用侵入性较小的解决方案，力求最大化当前设计的潜力，同时权衡性能提升与实现这些提升所需的资源。
新车身将伴随冷却百叶窗的修改，使热空气排出适应新的侧箱几何形状。进一步的冷却配置计划在接下来的墨西哥大奖赛上使用，届时法拉利预计将引入更大的开口，以应对高海拔带来的特别严苛条件。
这并不意味着法拉利没有考虑过更激进的替代方案。
在开发过程中，风洞中进行了大量迭代，探索不同的几何形状和车身概念，同时也考虑到了2027年项目的空气动力学选择。
在马拉内罗本赛季分析的解决方案中，包括红牛引入的侧箱设计，其特点是对有关底板车身支撑件的法规做出了有趣的解读。
在小红牛22上，以及从巴库站起在奥迪赛车上，连接底板与车身结构的支撑件也被用于空气动力学目的。通过支撑件与侧箱表面之间的圆角过渡，红牛成功塑造出特别激进的几何形状，因为现行规则允许20毫米的圆角半径。这有助于重现所谓的“水滑梯”通道，即引导气流流向赛车尾部的通道。
这一方案让一个主要承担结构功能的部件也能影响车身的形状和空气动力学表现。
法拉利仔细研究并评估了这一概念，但决定不将很大一部分资源投入到对SF-26侧箱如此大幅度的改造上。
这一决定主要是研发优先级的问题。
对侧箱理念进行大幅改动，本需要与空气动力学平台的其他部分（尤其是底板）进行整合工作，而且在剩余不多的比赛中无法确定能获得足够显著的优势。
因此，在马拉内罗，偏好是将精力集中在另一个仍被认为最具性能潜力的领域：底板。
至于新底板，改动不会局限于单一区域，而是将涉及对整个系统更广泛的修订，从前部一直到扩散器。
继续在这一部件上投入的决定，也与在赞德沃特引入的上一套套件所取得的结果有关。
这一开发成果被带到荷兰，是因为法拉利未能在短期内找到特别显著的改进机会，促使车队继续研究底板几何形状，以寻求专门为奥斯汀站带来更大幅度的提升。
SF-26在整个赛季中展现出了良好的基础设计，但工程师们仍在继续寻求提升赛车底部所产生的性能。
奥斯汀的新底板不仅旨在增加下压力，还旨在解决空气动力学平衡问题——目前平衡仍过于偏向前部——并拓宽工作窗口，正如红牛在一定程度上做到的那样。
美国大奖赛将是法拉利推出如此重要空气动力学套件的最后一场比赛。奥斯汀站之后，SF-26的开发将主要限于针对特定赛道的适配。
法拉利还利用多次风洞迭代探索了2027年的不同设计方向，届时新车将采用与SF-26相比有显著不同的空气动力学方案。
尽管如此，未来的法拉利仍将与当前项目保留一些延续性元素，尤其是在底盘方面——底盘一直是2026年赛车最令人信服的部分之一，同时2027年动力单元的工作也在并行推进。
奥斯汀还将提供一个机会，用来验证开发工具所得结果与赛车在赛道上的表现之间的相关性。
detailEn: Ferrari is preparing to introduce what will be its fourth and most significant aerodynamic upgrade package of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the United States Grand Prix.

The Austin upgrade is the final development package of this scale planned for the SF-26, while attention at Maranello has now largely shifted towards the development of next year's car, which will be completely different, both due to regulatory restrictions and fundamental aerodynamic choices.
The updates at the Circuit of the Americas will affect several areas of the car, with modifications to the floor, sidepods and upper bodywork.
Unlike some of its main rivals, according to our information, Ferrari has decided not to radically change the aerodynamic concept of its sidepods.

McLaren and Mercedes, the latter in particular, have recently made significant changes to their concepts with their latest upgrades, substantially modifying the shapes and the way airflow travels along the sidepods. Neither team appears to have immediately achieved on track what it had seen in the windtunnel and CFD simulations.
Ferrari, on the other hand, has preferred to maintain greater continuity with the SF-26's current architecture.

It is understood to have worked mainly on optimising its existing solutions, without making fundamental changes to the bodywork. The main objective is believed to be reducing drag, as the SF-26 still suffers somewhat in this area. (Which is not helped by Ferrari's less-powerful engine.)

The team has therefore preferred a less invasive solution, seeking to maximise the potential of the current design while weighing up the performance gains against the resources needed to achieve them.

The new bodywork will be accompanied by modifications to the cooling louvres, adapting hot-air extraction to the new sidepod geometries. Further cooling configurations are planned for the following Mexican GP, where Ferrari is expected to introduce larger openings to cope with the particularly demanding conditions imposed by the altitude.
This does not mean that more radical alternatives have not been considered by Ferrari.
During development, numerous iterations were carried out in the windtunnel, exploring different geometries and bodywork concepts, also with the aerodynamic choices for the 2027 project in mind.

Among the solutions analysed at Maranello during the season was the sidepod design introduced by Red Bull, characterised by an interesting interpretation of the regulations concerning the floor body stays.

On the RB22, and on the Audi from Baku onwards, the structural stay connecting the floor to the bodywork is also exploited for aerodynamic purposes. Through the fillet between the stay and the sidepod surfaces, Red Bull has managed to define a particularly aggressive geometry, as the current regulations allow a fillet radius of 20mm. This has helped recreate the so-called waterslides, the channels that guide airflow towards the rear of the car.
This solution allows an element that is primarily structural to also influence the shape and aerodynamic behaviour of the bodywork.
Ferrari carefully examined and evaluated this concept, but decided not to devote a significant proportion of its resources to such a substantial transformation of the SF-26's sidepods.
The decision was mainly a matter of development priorities.

A substantial change to the sidepod philosophy would have required integration work with the rest of the aerodynamic platform, particularly the floor, without any certainty of obtaining a sufficiently significant advantage in the few remaining races.
At Maranello, the preference was therefore to concentrate efforts on another area, still considered to offer the greatest performance potential: the floor.
As for the new floor, the changes will not be limited to a single area, but will involve a more extensive revision of the entire system, from the front section through to the diffuser.
The decision to continue investing in this component is also linked to the results obtained with the previous package introduced at Zandvoort.

The development brought to the Netherlands followed Ferrari's failure to identify particularly significant opportunities for improvement in the short term, prompting the team to continue working on the floor geometry in search of a more substantial gain specifically for Austin.
The SF-26 has shown a good underlying design throughout the season, but the engineers have continued to seek an increase in the performance generated by the underside of the car.

The new Austin floor has been developed not only with the aim of increasing downforce, but also of addressing the aerodynamic balance, which is still too heavily biased towards the front, and widening the operating window, as Red Bull has somewhat managed to do.

The US GP will be the final event at which Ferrari introduces an aerodynamic package of this significance. After Austin, development of the SF-26 will be mainly limited to circuit-specific adaptations.

Ferrari has also used the numerous windtunnel iterations to explore different design directions for 2027, when the new car will feature substantially different aerodynamic solutions compared to the SF-26.

The future Ferrari will nevertheless retain some elements of continuity with the current project, particularly regarding the chassis, which has been one of the most convincing aspects of the 2026 car, while work on the 2027 power unit continues in parallel.
Austin will also provide an opportunity to verify the correlation between the results obtained from development tools and the car's behaviour on track.
keyPointsZh: 这是SF-26计划中最后一次如此规模的开发包，马拉内罗的注意力已基本转向明年赛车
法拉利选择不彻底改变侧箱的空气动力学概念，与迈凯伦和梅赛德斯近期的做法不同
升级的主要目标被认为是降低阻力，SF-26在这一方面仍有不足
keyPointsEn: This is the final development package of this scale planned for the SF-26, with attention at Maranello now largely shifted to next year's car.
Ferrari has chosen not to radically change the aerodynamic concept of its sidepods, unlike recent moves by McLaren and Mercedes.
The main objective is believed to be reducing drag, an area where the SF-26 still suffers.

items.originalTitle: Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. I also feel I ne...
items.summaryEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.
detailZh:
兴奋的周末！很高兴驾驶我们的GT3赛车在波尔蒂芒参赛。有起有落，但作为团队，我们学到很多。
我也觉得有必要站出来谈谈克里斯在赛后所受到的仇恨和骚扰。每个人都可以对赛道上发生的事情有自己的看法，但这些个人攻击是不恰当的。
克里斯的表现非常出色，错误是会发生的。
在我们的运动或任何地方都不应该有这种虐待行为。
detailEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯何时将在2026年成为F1世界冠军？
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季的F1中，梅赛德斯回归了其过去的统治地位，有望赢得自COVID影响的2020赛季以来的首个双冠王胜利。

media.altZh: 梅赛德斯何时将在2026年成为F1世界冠军？ · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: When will Mercedes become F1 world champions in 2026?
detailZh: 梅赛德斯何时将在2026年成为F1世界冠军？
德国品牌正朝着赢得2026年F1车手和车队双冠王的目标迈进。
乔治·拉塞尔和安德烈亚·安东内利领跑车手积分榜，其中安东内利以102分的优势领先。
2026赛季的F1中，梅赛德斯回归了其过去的统治地位，有望赢得自COVID影响的2020赛季以来的首个双冠王胜利。
基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔领跑车手积分榜，前者领先102分，而梅赛德斯在车队积分榜上以134分的优势领先第二名的法拉利。
得益于在17场大奖赛中的11次胜利，银箭车队在新规则开始时处于这个位置，其中大部分胜利都是在早期取得的，因为随后对手缩小了差距。
尽管如此，梅赛德斯车队在经历了马克斯·维斯塔潘的统治和兰多·诺里斯夺冠之后，即将迎来自2020年以来的首个车手冠军，车队积分榜上也是类似的情况。
银箭车队上一次赢得该锦标赛是在2021年，在红牛和麦凯轮在地面效应时代超越它之前，但在2026年还剩下六轮比赛的情况下，梅赛德斯车队注定要取得荣耀。
安东内利有望在奥斯汀的下一场比赛中赢得他的首个世界冠军，尽管他更有可能在墨西哥的一周后实现这一目标，而梅赛德斯可能需要等待更长的时间才能赢得车队冠军。
有多少车队还能赢得2026年F1世界冠军？
安东内利，梅赛德斯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
在2026年F1世界车队锦标赛中，还剩下258个积分可供争夺，前提是卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛能在持续的中东冲突中得到顺利进行。
这意味着还有四支车队在数学上有机会赢得比赛，因为梅赛德斯领先法拉利134分，领先麦克拉伦239分，领先红牛246分——第五名的小红牛落后478分。
梅赛德斯能否在美国大奖赛上赢得2026年F1世界冠军？
当F1在下周末在奥斯汀迎来终点线时，2026年车队 constructors’ championship 还剩下215分可用。
这意味着美国大奖赛很可能会看到麦克拉伦和红牛退出竞争，因为他们需要在奥斯汀之后缩小到214分以内。
因为它比两支车队多赢九场比赛，所以如果麦凯轮和红牛在德克萨斯州将其差距缩小到215分，他们仍然会因为胜利次数的回溯而退出竞争。
鉴于这需要卫冕冠军和红牛分别至少比梅赛德斯多出25分和32分，法拉利是唯一可能威胁到德国品牌的威胁。
并且无论发生什么，斯库德里亚都将在美国仍然落后梅赛德斯214分以内，因此构造者冠军将在下个周末无法决定。
梅赛德斯什么时候能赢得2026年F1世界冠军？
法拉利在奥斯汀的最坏情况是，它将获得双非积分，而梅赛德斯车队以1-2的成绩结束，这将使它们之间有177分的差距。
如果这种不太可能的情况发生，德国品牌将有机会在墨西哥城获得其第九个车队总冠军，这将使它在所有时间榜上与威廉姆斯车队持平，排在法拉利（16分）和麦克拉伦车队（10分）之后。
再次强调，如果卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛顺利进行，墨西哥之后的四场大奖赛将提供172分。因此，如果奥斯汀的情况如上所述发生，梅赛德斯车队只需确保在墨西哥不要落后法拉利至少6分即可。
然而，在本赛季的任何时候，梅赛德斯车队都没有在法拉利一分未得的情况下从大奖赛中全取积分，如下表所示——不包括冲刺赛，因为2026年已经没有剩余的冲刺赛了。
看着这个，梅赛德斯在17场大奖赛中的平均得分比法拉利高出7.6分，如果这种情况在接下来的两场比赛中发生，那么差距将达到149分。
因此，即使梅赛德斯在墨西哥夺冠也是一个艰巨的任务。F1很可能会在巴西大奖赛之后，也就是下一站，看到银箭车队可能成为世界冠军。
detailEn: When will Mercedes become F1 world champions in 2026?
The German marque is on course to win both the F1 2026 drivers' and constructors' titles
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
The 2026 Formula 1 season has seen Mercedes return to its dominant past as it is on course to claim its first double championship victory since the COVID-struck 2020 campaign.
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell top the drivers’ standings with the former holding a 102-point advantage, while Mercedes leads second-placed Ferrari by 134 points in the constructors’ table.

It is thanks to 11 victories in 17 grands prix that the Silver Arrows is in this position at the start of the new regulations, most of those wins coming early on as rivals subsequently closed the gap.
Regardless, Mercedes is set for its first drivers’ title since 2020 after a period of Max Verstappen domination and a crown for Lando Norris, with it being a similar story in the constructors.
The Silver Arrows last won that championship in 2021 before Red Bull and McLaren overtook it during the ground-effect era, but with six rounds remaining in 2026, Mercedes is set for glory.

Antonelli can clinch his maiden world title next time out in Austin, though is most likely going to do it a week later in Mexico, whereas Mercedes may have to wait a little longer to win the teams’ crown.
How many teams can still win the F1 2026 world title?
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
There are 258 points left on offer in the 2026 F1 world constructors’ championship table, provided Qatar and Abu Dhabi go ahead amid the ongoing Middle Eastern conflict.
That means there are four teams left with a mathematical shot, as Mercedes leads Ferrari by 134 points, McLaren by 239 and Red Bull by 246 - fifth-placed Racing Bulls is 478 behind.
Can Mercedes win the F1 2026 world title at the US GP?
When F1 greets the chequered flag in Austin next weekend, there will be 215 points left available in the 2026 constructors’ championship.
That means the United States Grand Prix is likely to see McLaren and Red Bull drop out of contention, as they would need to be within 214 points post-Austin.
It is because Mercedes has nine more wins than both squads, so if McLaren and Red Bull cut it to 215 in Texas, they would still be eliminated from the fight due to countback of victories.
Given that would require the reigning champions and Red Bull outscoring Mercedes by at least 25 and 32 points respectively, Ferrari is realistically the only threat to the German marque.
And because the Scuderia will leave the United States still within 214 points of Mercedes regardless of what happens, the constructors’ title will not be decided next weekend.
When can Mercedes win the F1 2026 world title?
The worst-case scenario for Ferrari in Austin is that it experiences a double non-points score with Mercedes finishing 1-2, which would leave a 177-point gap between them.

If that unlikely scenario happens, the German marque heads to Mexico City with a chance of claiming its ninth constructors’ title - moving level with Williams on the all-time list behind Ferrari (16) and McLaren (10).

Again, provided Qatar and Abu Dhabi go ahead, there are 172 points available in the four grands prix after Mexico. So, if the above scenario in Austin happens, Mercedes would just need to make sure that Ferrari doesn’t outscore it by at least six points in Mexico.
Yet at no point this season has Mercedes taken a full score from a grand prix with Ferrari taking nothing, as the below table indicates - excluding sprint races as there are none left in 2026.
Looking at that, Mercedes has outscored Ferrari by an average of 7.6 points across the 17 grands prix so if that were to happen across the next two, it leaves a gap of 149 points.
So even for Mercedes to clinch the title in Mexico is a tough ask. F1 is most likely looking at the grand prix afterwards, in Brazil, where the Silver Arrows could become world champions.

items.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁神秘单座赛车再现保罗·里卡德测试
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁一款受F1启发的神秘单座赛车再次现身，新视频显示其在法国保罗·里卡德赛道测试。该车最早于4月出现在网上，此后曾在私人机场和葡萄牙波尔蒂芒出现。
items.originalTitle: Aston Martin's F1-inspired monster spotted testing as record-breaking claims emerge
items.summaryEn: A mysterious Aston Martin single-seater inspired by Formula 1 has been spotted again, with new footage showing it testing at Paul Ricard in France. The car first appeared online in April and has since shown up at a private airfield and at Portimao in Portugal.
detailZh: 阿斯顿·马丁受F1启发的怪兽赛车现身测试，破纪录说法随之出现
新视频显示阿斯顿·马丁的神秘一次性赛道赛车在保罗·里卡德测试
#009 阿斯顿·马丁 Thor 车队 阿斯顿·马丁 Valkyrie：亚历克斯·里贝拉斯、马尔科·索伦森
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
阿斯顿·马丁的神秘单座赛车重返赛道，它看起来依然与发车区或经销商里的任何其他车型截然不同。
Reddit上分享的新视频显示，这辆车正在法国南部的保罗·里卡尔赛道飞驰。这是这台机器的最新一次现身，它最早于今年四月出现在网上，此后又先后在私人机场和葡萄牙的波尔蒂芒被人拍到。那么，这台造型惊艳、阿斯顿·马丁却对其保持沉默的机器，究竟是什么？
这个设计或许与我们过去几年见过的几款超级跑车有些相似。从座舱往前看，它大量借鉴了一级方程式赛车的元素：狭窄的车鼻、外露的悬挂臂，以及座舱上方看似光环（halo）的结构。再往后，车身覆盖了车轮，尾部看起来更接近勒芒原型车，风格上承袭了阿斯顿·马丁的瓦尔基里超级跑车。
它实际上是一级方程式赛车与仅限赛道使用的瓦尔基里之间的跨界产物，打造目标只有一个：比两者都跑得更快。
今年四月，德国杂志《Auto Motor und Sport》报道称，这辆车是美国亿万富翁、Citadel对冲基金创始人肯·格里芬委托定制的一次性作品。据报道，格里芬要求阿斯顿·马丁打造世界上最快的赛道跑车。阿斯顿有一些快车，但显然没有最快的。于是它只能从头开始设计。
据了解，这个想法最初是作为概念车在银石赛道向一小群客户展示的，据说与阿斯顿·马丁一级方程式车队有关联的工程咨询公司阿斯顿·马丁性能技术部门负责监督开发。一些报道暗示阿德里安·纽维可能参与其中。虽然这仍有待证实，但它看起来确实像那位疯狂科学家会在其著名笔记本上画出的东西。
它靠什么驱动？
目前尚未确认任何信息，但声浪已经给了我们所需的所有线索。听过这段视频的媒体一致认为，它听起来像是瓦尔基里上使用的考斯沃斯制造的6.5升V12发动机，在公路车上借助混合动力辅助可输出约1160马力。
关于这款一次性车型是保留混合动力系统，还是像仅限赛道使用的Valkyrie AMR Pro那样单独运行V12发动机，各方报道存在分歧。有传言称总输出功率约为1,200马力。
比F1赛车还快？
《汽车与运动》杂志提出的一个可能令人担忧的重大主张是，这款车可能比F1赛车快得多。这说得通，因为在严肃超级跑车的世界里，几乎没有多少法规限制，没有最低重量要求，当然也没有空气动力学限制。这意味着可能性几乎无穷无尽（取决于项目背后的预算）。
如果它接近那个速度，它将成为绝对赛道纪录的有力竞争者，包括保时捷919 Evo在纽博格林北环赛道创下的5分19.55秒单圈成绩。
这不会是唯一一辆追求这一理念的汽车。红牛的小红牛17由纽维在转投阿斯顿·马丁之前开发，目标客户群类似，都是财力雄厚、想要拥有超越F1速度的买家。
目前，这辆一次性样车仍在测试中，阿斯顿·马丁对何时或是否会展示成品车保持沉默。
detailEn: Aston Martin's F1-inspired monster spotted testing as record-breaking claims emerge
New footage shows Aston Martin's mysterious one-off track car testing at Paul Ricard
#009 Aston Martin Thor Team Aston Martin Valkyrie: Alex Riberas, Marco Sorensen
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Aston Martin's mystery single-seater is back on track, and it still looks like nothing else on the grid or in a dealer.

New footage shared on Reddit shows the car lapping Paul Ricard in the south of France. It is the latest sighting of a machine that first appeared online in April and has since popped up at a private airfield and at Portimao in Portugal. So what is this fantastic-looking machine that Aston Martin has been radio silent about?

The design is maybe similar to a few other hypercars we've seen released over the past few years. From the cockpit forward, it borrows heavily from Formula 1, with a narrow nose, exposed suspension arms and what appears to be a halo over the cockpit. Further back, bodywork covers the wheels and the rear end looks closer to a Le Mans prototype, leaning on Aston's Valkyrie hypercar.
It is effectively a cross between an F1 car and a track-only Valkyrie, built with one aim: to go faster than either.

In April, German magazine Auto Motor und Sport reported that the car is a one-off commissioned by Ken Griffin, the American billionaire who founded the Citadel hedge fund. According to the report, Griffin asked Aston Martin for the fastest track car in the world. Aston had some fast cars, but it certainly didn't have the fastest. So it took to the drawing board.

The idea is understood to have started life as a concept shown to a small group of clients at Silverstone, with Aston Martin Performance Technologies, the engineering consultancy linked to its Formula 1 team, said to be overseeing development. Some reports have suggested Adrian Newey could be involved. While that remains to be confirmed, it does look like something that mad scientist would draw up in his famous notebook.
What powers it?

Nothing has been confirmed, but the soundtrack is giving us all the clues we need. Outlets that have heard the footage agree it sounds like the Cosworth-built 6.5-litre V12 used in the Valkyrie, which makes around 1,160hp with a bit of hybrid assistance in the road car.
Reports differ on whether this one-off keeps the hybrid system or runs the V12 on its own, as the track-only Valkyrie AMR Pro does. Rumours put total output at roughly 1,200hp.
Faster than an F1 car?

The big, maybe worrying claim from Auto Motor und Sport is that the car could be much faster than an F1 car. And that makes sense, because in the world of serious-looking hypercars, there are very few regulations to build within, no minimum weights, and certainly no aero limitations. This means the possibilities are almost endless (depending on the budget you have behind the project).
If it is anywhere near that pace, it would be a serious contender for outright track records, including the Porsche 919 Evo's 5min 19.55sec lap of the Nurburgring Nordschleife.
It would not be the only car chasing that idea. Red Bull's RB17, developed under Newey before his move to Aston Martin, is aimed at a similar group of heavy-walleted buyers who want F1-beating pace.
For now, the one-off remains in testing, and Aston Martin is keeping quiet about when, or whether, it will show the finished car.

items.titleZh: 处罚为范斯特appen的GT回归赛事带来史诗般的挑战
items.summaryZh: 范斯特appen在F1大奖赛间歇期回归GT赛车运动，经历了许多戏剧性事件，最终获得前十名完赛，并吸引了大量观众。
items.originalTitle: Penalty sets up epic Verstappen charge in his GT return
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在一级方程式大奖赛之间的休息期间重返GT赛车，在这场比赛中充满了戏剧性，最终获得了前十名的好成绩，并吸引了大量观众（在线和现场）来到波尔蒂马奥GT世界挑战赛。
在一次设置失误后，维斯塔潘车队由2 Seas Motorsport运营的梅赛德斯在周五晚上的排位赛中火花四溅，仅以第15位的成绩进入发车网格。
维斯塔潘的车队队友本·巴尼科特和克里斯·卢尔汉在第一和第二次练习中迅速前进，巴尼科特很快进入前十，而卢尔汉在接管方向盘后正朝着前五名冲刺。
但卢尔汉随后因为帮助卢卡·斯托兹的梅赛德斯在安全车后的重启圈中打转而受到罚站处罚，试图在第五位发车。
Lulham在将赛车交给维斯塔潘之前，刚刚完成了那次罚令，因此维斯塔潘在剩余45分钟夜间比赛的时间里，从第24位起步。
另一辆长时间的安全车让维斯塔潘失去了几个赛段来弥补差距，但至少让车队之间的距离缩小了。
重启时还剩下23分钟，那时维斯塔潘已经排在第19位。他展现了一场精彩的冲刺，其中包括与查尔斯·勒克莱尔兄弟阿瑟在AF Corse法拉利的特别有趣的战斗，并至少保住了第九名的成绩。
这足以让维斯塔潘在回到维修区时露出大大的笑容，并在主看台的人群中引起了一阵热烈的欢呼声。
Ralf Aron、Fabian Schiller和Maxi Gotz驾驶的GetSpeed奔驰车队获得了胜利。
detailEn: Max Verstappen's return to GT racing in the pause between Formula 1 grands prix featured plenty of drama, an eventual top-10 finish, and brought a huge audience (both online and at the track) to the Portimao GT World Challenge event.
A set-up miscue had left the Verstappen team's 2 Seas Motorsport-run Mercedes scraping its way to just 15th on the grid in a shower of sparks during Friday evening's qualifying session.

Verstappen's team-mates Ben Barnicoat and Chris Lulham made rapid progress forward as they took the first two stints, with Barnicoat soon into the top 10 and Lulham charging towards the top five when he took the wheel.
But Lulham then incurred a drivethrough penalty for assisting Luca Stolz's Mercedes into a spin as he tried to take fifth on a restart lap following a safety car.
Lulham took that penalty just before handing over to Verstappen, who therefore took over down in 24th place with just 45 minutes of after-dark racing to go.
Another long safety car cost Verstappen some racing laps to make up ground but did at least close the pack up.

There were 23 minutes left at the restart, with Verstappen 19th by then. He produced a spectacular charge forward that included a particularly entertaining battle with Charles Leclerc's brother Arthur in an AF Corse Ferrari, and managed to at least salvage a top-1o finish in ninth.
That was enough to prompt a massive grin from Verstappen as he got back to the pits, and a huge cheer from the crowd in the main grandstand.
The GetSpeed Mercedes of Ralf Aron, Fabian Schiller and Maxi Gotz took victory.
